desc.de: Dedizierte HSM-Instanzen (FIPS 140-2 bzw. FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validiert). Volle Key-Kontrolle, PKCS#11/JCE/OpenSSL-Zugriff, Custom Key Store für KMS, Cluster-HA.
desc.en: Dedicated HSM instances (FIPS 140-2 or FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validated). Full key control, PKCS#11/JCE/OpenSSL access, custom key store for KMS, cluster HA.

tcpDesc.de: Kein Dedicated HSM auf T Cloud Public. T Cloud Public KMS nutzt shared HSMs im Backend — die HSMs erfüllen laut T Cloud Public-Doku und Leistungsbeschreibung die Anforderungen von FIPS 140-2 Level 3. Kein eigener HSM-Zugriff möglich.
tcpDesc.en: No dedicated HSM on T Cloud Public. T Cloud Public KMS uses shared HSMs in the backend — per T Cloud Public docs and service description the HSMs meet FIPS 140-2 Level 3 requirements. No direct HSM access possible.

alt.de: T Cloud Public KMS (HSM-backed), HashiCorp Vault Transit
alt.en: T Cloud Public KMS (HSM-backed), HashiCorp Vault Transit

migration.de: **Kein Dedicated HSM.** T Cloud Public KMS nutzt shared HSMs im Backend (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign/Verify mit RSA/ECC/AES), die laut Doku und Leistungsbeschreibung die Anforderungen von FIPS 140-2 Level 3 erfüllen — Zertifikatsnachweis bei Compliance-Anforderungen bei T-Systems anfragen. **Kein PKCS#11-Zugriff.** Kein direkter PKCS#11-, JCE- oder OpenSSL-Zugriff wie bei CloudHSM. Kein Custom Key Store. **Key-Transfer.** Key-Export aus CloudHSM ist bei non-extractable Keys nicht möglich — in T Cloud Public KMS neu generieren. Alle abhängigen Zertifikate und Signaturen müssen erneuert werden. **Vault-Alternative.** HashiCorp Vault Transit auf CCE (PKCS#11-kompatibel) für erweiterte Crypto-Operationen.
migration.en: **No Dedicated HSM.** T Cloud Public KMS uses shared HSMs in the backend (encrypt/decrypt/sign/verify with RSA/ECC/AES), which per docs and service description meet FIPS 140-2 Level 3 requirements — request the certificate from T-Systems if compliance requires it. **No PKCS#11 access.** No direct PKCS#11, JCE, or OpenSSL access as with CloudHSM. No custom key store. **Key transfer.** Key export from CloudHSM not possible for non-extractable keys — regenerate in T Cloud Public KMS. All dependent certificates and signatures must be renewed. **Vault alternative.** HashiCorp Vault Transit on CCE (PKCS#11-compatible) for extended crypto operations.

desc.de: Key Management Service. Symmetrische/asymmetrische CMKs, automatische Rotation (konfigurierbar 90-2560 Tage), Key Import, Grants, Multi-Region Keys, Audit via CloudTrail.
desc.en: Key Management Service. Symmetric/asymmetric CMKs, automatic rotation (configurable 90-2560 days), key import, grants, multi-region keys, audit via CloudTrail.

tcpDesc.de: Zentrale Schlüsselverwaltung: AES_256 (symmetrisch), RSA_2048/3072/4096, EC_P256/P384, SECP256K1 (asymmetrisch), HMAC_256/384/512. HSM-backed (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). Automatische Rotation für symmetrische Keys (Intervall 30–365 Tage, Default 365). Key-Import (BYOK) unterstützt. Integration mit OBS, EVS, IMS, SFS, RDS, DDS, GaussDB. Audit über CTS.
tcpDesc.en: Central key management: AES_256 (symmetric), RSA_2048/3072/4096, EC_P256/P384, SECP256K1 (asymmetric), HMAC_256/384/512. HSM-backed (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). Automatic rotation for symmetric keys (interval 30–365 days, default 365). Key import (BYOK) supported. Integration with OBS, EVS, IMS, SFS, RDS, DDS, GaussDB. Audit via CTS.

migration.de: **Algorithmen & FIPS.** T Cloud Public KMS unterstützt AES_256, RSA_2048/3072/4096, EC_P256/P384, SECP256K1 und HMAC. HSMs erfüllen laut Doku FIPS 140-2 Level 3. **Rotation & Policies.** Automatische Key-Rotation nur für symmetrische Keys, Intervall 30–365 Tage (AWS: 90–2560 Tage). Key Policies haben kein direktes Pendant — Berechtigungen über IAM-Policies/Agencies steuern; Grants sind vorhanden. **Kein Multi-Region.** Multi-Region Keys existieren nicht. **BYOK-Wrapping.** Key-Import (BYOK) wird unterstützt, Wrapping-Algorithmen RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256, RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1 und RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5 (AWS: RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256/SHA_1, zusätzlich RSA_AES_KEY_WRAP_SHA_256/SHA_1 für asymmetrisches Key-Material). **Daten-Reencryption.** Mit AWS KMS verschlüsselte Daten müssen entschlüsselt und mit T Cloud Public KMS neu verschlüsselt werden — kein Key-Transfer möglich. Integration mit OBS, EVS, IMS, SFS, RDS, DDS, GaussDB.
migration.en: **Algorithms & FIPS.** T Cloud Public KMS supports AES_256, RSA_2048/3072/4096, EC_P256/P384, SECP256K1, and HMAC. Per docs the HSMs meet FIPS 140-2 Level 3. **Rotation & policies.** Automatic key rotation only for symmetric keys, interval 30–365 days (AWS: 90–2560 days). Key Policies have no direct equivalent — manage permissions via IAM policies/agencies; Grants are available. **No multi-region.** Multi-Region Keys don't exist. **BYOK wrapping.** Key import (BYOK) supported, wrapping algorithms RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256, RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1, and RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5 (AWS: RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256/SHA_1, plus RSA_AES_KEY_WRAP_SHA_256/SHA_1 for asymmetric key material). **Data re-encryption.** Data encrypted with AWS KMS must be decrypted and re-encrypted with T Cloud Public KMS — no key transfer possible. Integration with OBS, EVS, IMS, SFS, RDS, DDS, GaussDB.

equivNote.de: T Cloud Public KMS unterstützt AES_256, RSA (2048/3072/4096), ECC (P256/P384, SECP256K1) und HMAC. HSM-backed (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). Automatische Rotation nur für symmetrische Keys, 30–365 Tage (AWS: 90–2560 Tage). Key-Import (BYOK) mit RSA-Wrapping. Kein Multi-Region Key, kein eigenständiges Key Policy Document, weniger Condition Keys. Grants vorhanden aber eingeschränkter.
equivNote.en: T Cloud Public KMS supports AES_256, RSA (2048/3072/4096), ECC (P256/P384, SECP256K1), and HMAC. HSM-backed (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). Automatic rotation only for symmetric keys, 30–365 days (AWS: 90–2560 days). Key import (BYOK) with RSA wrapping. No multi-region keys, no standalone key policy document, fewer condition keys. Grants available but more limited.

desc.de: Web Application Firewall. Managed Rules (AWS + Marketplace), Custom Rules, Bot Control, Fraud Control, IP Sets, Rate-based Rules, Integration mit CloudFront/ALB/API GW/AppSync.
desc.en: Web Application Firewall. Managed rules (AWS + Marketplace), custom rules, bot control, fraud control, IP sets, rate-based rules, integration with CloudFront/ALB/API GW/AppSync.

tcpDesc.de: Zwei Modi: Cloud-WAF (DNS-basiert, CNAME-Umleitung) und Dedicated WAF (eigene WAF-Instanzen hinter ELB). OWASP Top 10, CC-Protection, Anti-Crawler (Script/Scanner/Search-Engine), Geolocation-Kontrolle, Web Tamper Protection, IP-Blacklist/Whitelist, Precise Protection, Information Leakage Prevention, Data Masking. Logging nach LTS, Monitoring via Cloud Eye. Schützt HTTP/HTTPS-Websites. ⚠️ WAF Classic: End of Sale 01.06.2026, End of Maintenance 01.10.2026 — neue Setups nur mit Cloud-Modus oder Dedicated WAF.
tcpDesc.en: Two modes: Cloud WAF (DNS-based, CNAME redirect) and Dedicated WAF (own WAF instances behind ELB). OWASP Top 10, CC protection, anti-crawler (script/scanner/search-engine), geolocation control, web tamper protection, IP blacklist/whitelist, precise protection, information leakage prevention, data masking. Logging to LTS, monitoring via Cloud Eye. Protects HTTP/HTTPS websites. ⚠️ WAF Classic: end of sale 01.06.2026, end of maintenance 01.10.2026 — new setups only with cloud mode or dedicated WAF.

migration.de: **Deployment-Modi.** Cloud-WAF (DNS-basiert, CNAME-Umleitung, shared) und Dedicated WAF (eigene Instanzen hinter ELB, bessere Performance, VPC-intern). **Regel-Umfang.** OWASP Top 10, CC Attack Protection (entspricht Rate-based Rules), Anti-Crawler, Geolocation Access Control, Web Tamper Protection, IP Blacklist/Whitelist, Information Leakage Prevention, Data Masking, Known Attack Source Blocking. **Fehlende Bot-Kontrolle.** AWS WAF Bot Control, Fraud Control und Account Takeover Prevention haben kein direktes Pendant — T Cloud Public Anti-Crawler ist weniger granular. **Keine Managed Rules.** Managed Rule Groups (AWS Marketplace) fehlen — eigene Regeln schreiben oder WAF-Anbieter (z.B. Cloudflare) vorschalten. **Logging & Scope.** WAF Logging → LTS. WAF schützt Domains/IPs von Webanwendungen (HTTP/HTTPS) — Cloud-Modus per CNAME, Dedicated per ELB; kein Schutz für Nicht-HTTP-Dienste.
migration.en: **Deployment modes.** Cloud WAF (DNS-based, CNAME redirect, shared) and Dedicated WAF (own instances behind ELB, better performance, VPC-internal). **Rule scope.** OWASP Top 10, CC Attack Protection (corresponds to rate-based rules), anti-crawler, geolocation access control, web tamper protection, IP blacklist/whitelist, information leakage prevention, data masking, Known Attack Source Blocking. **No bot control.** AWS WAF Bot Control, Fraud Control, and Account Takeover Prevention have no direct equivalent — T Cloud Public anti-crawler is less granular. **No managed rules.** Managed Rule Groups (AWS Marketplace) are missing — write custom rules or put WAF provider (e.g. Cloudflare) in front. **Logging & scope.** WAF Logging → LTS. WAF protects domains/IPs of web applications (HTTP/HTTPS) — cloud mode via CNAME, dedicated via ELB; no protection for non-HTTP services.

equivNote.de: T Cloud Public WAF bietet Cloud-WAF (DNS/CNAME) und Dedicated WAF (eigene Instanzen). OWASP Top 10, CC Protection, Anti-Crawler, Geolocation, IP-Blacklisting vorhanden. Kein AWS WAF Bot Control, kein Managed Rule Groups (Marketplace), keine Firewall Manager Integration, kein Rate-based Rules API-Format — CC Protection ist anders konfiguriert.
equivNote.en: T Cloud Public WAF offers Cloud WAF (DNS/CNAME) and Dedicated WAF (own instances). OWASP Top 10, CC protection, anti-crawler, geolocation, IP blacklisting available. No AWS WAF Bot Control, no managed rule groups (marketplace), no Firewall Manager integration, no rate-based rules API format — CC protection is configured differently.

desc.de: Automatisiertes Vulnerability Scanning für EC2, ECR-Images und Lambda. CVE-DB (NVD), CIS Benchmarks, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), Network Reachability, agentless + agent-basiert.
desc.en: Automated vulnerability scanning for EC2, ECR images and Lambda. CVE DB (NVD), CIS benchmarks, software bill of materials (SBOM), network reachability, agentless + agent-based.

tcpDesc.de: HSS (Host Security Service) mit vier Editionen: Enterprise (Vulnerability Scan, Baseline Check, Asset Discovery, Intrusion Detection, File Integrity), Premium (+ Ransomware Protection, Application Protection, Application Process Control), WTP (+ Web Tamper Protection), Container (+ Container Image Scan, Runtime Protection, Cluster Protection). Agent-basiert (HSS-Agent). Kein agentless Scanning.
tcpDesc.en: HSS (Host Security Service) with four editions: Enterprise (vulnerability scan, baseline check, asset discovery, intrusion detection, file integrity), Premium (+ ransomware protection, application protection, application process control), WTP (+ web tamper protection), Container (+ container image scan, runtime protection, cluster protection). Agent-based (HSS agent). No agentless scanning.

alt.de: Trivy, Wazuh, OpenSCAP, Qualys, T Cloud Public Vulnerability Scan Service (VSS)
alt.en: Trivy, Wazuh, OpenSCAP, Qualys, T Cloud Public Vulnerability Scan Service (VSS)

migration.de: **Agent-Pflicht.** HSS erfordert HSS-Agent auf jeder Instanz — kein agentless Scanning wie Inspector. **Editionen.** Enterprise (Vuln Scan + Baseline + Asset Discovery + Intrusion Detection + File Integrity), Premium (+ Ransomware + Application Protection + Process Control), WTP (+ Web Tamper Protection), Container (+ Image Scan + Runtime + Cluster Protection). **Container-Scanning.** Nur in Container Edition verfügbar (Aufpreis). Kein automatischer Scan bei SWR Push. **Fehlend.** Inspector Network Reachability Analysis, Lambda Function Scanning und SBOM-Export haben kein Pendant.
migration.en: **Agent required.** HSS requires HSS agent on every instance — no agentless scanning like Inspector. **Editions.** Enterprise (vuln scan + baseline + asset discovery + intrusion detection + file integrity), Premium (+ ransomware + application protection + process control), WTP (+ web tamper protection), Container (+ image scan + runtime + cluster protection). **Container scanning.** Only in Container edition (surcharge). No automatic scan on SWR push. **Missing.** Inspector Network Reachability Analysis, Lambda Function Scanning, and SBOM export have no equivalent.

equivNote.de: HSS ist agent-basiert (kein agentless Scanning). Vier Editionen von Enterprise bis Container mit unterschiedlichem Funktionsumfang. Kein Network Reachability Analysis, kein Lambda Scanning, kein SBOM-Export. Dafür zusätzlich: Virus Scanning, Intrusion Detection und File Integrity.
equivNote.en: HSS is agent-based (no agentless scanning). Four editions from Enterprise to Container with different feature scope. No network reachability analysis, no Lambda scanning, no SBOM export. Additional features: virus scanning, intrusion detection, and file integrity.

tfNote.de: Nur Host Protection konfigurierbar. Scan-Policies und Vulnerability-Reports nicht per TF steuerbar.
tfNote.en: Only host protection configurable. Scan policies and vulnerability reports not manageable via TF.

desc.de: Zentrales Security Dashboard. Korreliert Findings von GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie und Security Hub CSPM (CIS/PCI-DSS/NIST Compliance Checks, ASFF) zu Exposure Findings mit Attack-Path-Graph (OCSF-Format). Automated Response.
desc.en: Central security dashboard. Correlates findings from GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie and Security Hub CSPM (CIS/PCI DSS/NIST compliance checks, ASFF) into exposure findings with attack path graph (OCSF format). Automated response.

tcpDesc.de: Kein zentraler Security-Findings-Aggregator. HSS Dashboard bietet Security Score und Risiko-Übersicht, aber nur für HSS-Findings. SecMaster (cloud-native SIEM/SOAR mit Asset-, Posture-, Incident-Management) ist laut Roadmap ab Q2 2027 geplant. Bis dahin: CTS + Cloud Eye + HSS als Einzellösungen.
tcpDesc.en: No central security findings aggregator. HSS Dashboard provides security score and risk overview, but only for HSS findings. SecMaster (cloud-native SIEM/SOAR with asset, posture, incident management) is planned per roadmap from Q2 2027. Until then: CTS + Cloud Eye + HSS as individual solutions.

alt.de: Wazuh SIEM, ELK/Splunk, Grafana, T Cloud Public HSS Dashboard (begrenzt)
alt.en: Wazuh SIEM, ELK/Splunk, Grafana, T Cloud Public HSS Dashboard (limited)

migration.de: **Kein Aggregator.** Kein zentraler Security-Findings-Aggregator auf T Cloud Public. HSS bietet ein Dashboard mit Security Score, aber nur für eigene Findings (kein Cross-Service-Aggregator). **SecMaster-Roadmap.** SecMaster (SIEM/SOAR mit Cloud Security Posture Management, Asset Management, Incident Management) ist laut T Cloud Public Roadmap ab Q2 2027 angekündigt. **Interim-Lösung.** CTS für Audit-Logs, Cloud Eye für Metriken-basierte Alarme, HSS für Host/Container-Security kombinieren. **Compliance-Checks.** CIS-, PCI-DSS-Checks müssen mit externen Tools (Prowler, ScoutSuite, Wazuh) selbst durchgeführt werden.
migration.en: **No aggregator.** No central security findings aggregator on T Cloud Public. HSS offers a dashboard with security score, but only for its own findings (no cross-service aggregator). **SecMaster roadmap.** SecMaster (SIEM/SOAR with cloud security posture management, asset management, incident management) is announced per T Cloud Public roadmap from Q2 2027. **Interim solution.** Combine CTS for audit logs, Cloud Eye for metrics-based alarms, HSS for host/container security. **Compliance checks.** CIS, PCI DSS checks must be performed with external tools (Prowler, ScoutSuite, Wazuh).

desc.de: ML-basierte Bedrohungserkennung. Analysiert CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS-Logs, S3-Daten-Events, EKS Audit Logs, RDS-Login-Aktivität, Lambda Network Activity. Malware Protection (EC2, S3), Runtime Monitoring (EKS/ECS/EC2, per Security Agent), Extended Threat Detection (Multi-Stage-Angriffe). Basis-Findings ohne Agent-Installation.
desc.en: ML-based threat detection. Analyzes CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, DNS logs, S3 data events, EKS audit logs, RDS login activity, Lambda network activity. Malware Protection (EC2, S3), Runtime Monitoring (EKS/ECS/EC2, via security agent), Extended Threat Detection (multi-stage attacks). Foundational findings without agent installation.

tcpDesc.de: Kein ML-basierter Threat Detection Service auf Cloud-Ebene. HSS (Host Security Service) bietet auf Host-Ebene: Brute-Force-Erkennung, abnormale Login-Erkennung, Reverse Shell Detection, Malware-Erkennung, Web Shell Detection, Process Anomaly Detection. Agent-basiert (HSS-Agent auf ECS installieren). SecMaster (Threat Detection/SIEM) ist laut Roadmap ab Q2 2027 geplant.
tcpDesc.en: No ML-based threat detection service at cloud level. HSS (Host Security Service) provides at host level: brute-force detection, abnormal login detection, reverse shell detection, malware detection, web shell detection, process anomaly detection. Agent-based (install HSS agent on ECS). SecMaster (threat detection/SIEM) is planned on the roadmap from Q2 2027.

alt.de: Wazuh, Suricata IDS, T Cloud Public HSS Intrusion Detection (Host-Ebene)
alt.en: Wazuh, Suricata IDS, T Cloud Public HSS Intrusion Detection (host-level)

migration.de: **Kein Cloud-Level Pendant.** GuardDuty analysiert Cloud-APIs und Netzwerk agentless — das gibt es auf T Cloud Public nicht. **HSS als Teilersatz.** Host-basierte Intrusion Detection (agent-basiert): Brute-Force, abnormale Logins, Reverse Shells, Web Shells, Malware, Process Anomalies, Ransomware Protection. **Log-Korrelation.** Automatische Korrelation von VPC Flow Logs, DNS-Logs und CTS-Events fehlt. Muss mit externem SIEM nachgebaut werden (Wazuh, ELK, Splunk). **Ergänzende Services.** CTS für API-Audit-Logs, DBSS für Datenbank-Sicherheit.
migration.en: **No cloud-level equivalent.** GuardDuty analyzes cloud APIs and network agentlessly — this doesn't exist on T Cloud Public. **HSS as partial replacement.** Host-based intrusion detection (agent-based): brute-force, abnormal logins, reverse shells, web shells, malware, process anomalies, ransomware protection. **Log correlation.** Automatic correlation of VPC Flow Logs, DNS logs, and CTS events is missing. Must be rebuilt with external SIEM (Wazuh, ELK, Splunk). **Supplementary services.** CTS for API audit logs, DBSS for database security.

desc.de: Managed Secrets-Speicher mit automatischer Rotation (Lambda-basiert). KMS-Verschlüsselung, Cross-Region Replication, Resource-based Policies, native RDS/Redshift/DocumentDB-Integration.
desc.en: Managed secrets store with automatic rotation (Lambda-based). KMS encryption, cross-region replication, resource-based policies, native RDS/Redshift/DocumentDB integration.

tcpDesc.de: CSMS ist in der Leistungsbeschreibung (Stand 09.10.2026, §3.9.9) bereits beschrieben und bepreist (nur EU-DE), laut Leistungsbeschreibung jedoch erst ab 01.04.2027 verfügbar; die Roadmap führt CSMS ab Q3 2027. Die Doku (Data Encryption Workshop, Abschnitt CSMS) ist seit 31.03.2026 veröffentlicht. Vorgesehen ist ein zentraler Dienst zum Erstellen, Abrufen, Aktualisieren und Löschen von Credentials über deren Lebenszyklus. Bis dahin: HashiCorp Vault auf CCE (empfohlen) oder Kubernetes Secrets mit KMS-Verschlüsselung als Workaround.
tcpDesc.en: CSMS is already described and priced in the service description (as of 09.10.2026, §3.9.9, EU-DE only), but only expected to be available from 01.04.2027; the roadmap lists CSMS from Q3 2027. Documentation (Data Encryption Workshop, CSMS section) has been published since 31.03.2026. It is intended as a central service for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting credentials throughout their lifecycle. Until then: HashiCorp Vault on CCE (recommended) or Kubernetes Secrets with KMS encryption as workaround.

alt.de: HashiCorp Vault (auf CCE), Kubernetes Secrets + KMS, Ansible Vault
alt.en: HashiCorp Vault (on CCE), Kubernetes Secrets + KMS, Ansible Vault

migration.de: **CSMS noch nicht verfügbar.** T Cloud Public CSMS (Cloud Secret Management Service) ist laut Leistungsbeschreibung ab 01.04.2027, laut Roadmap ab Q3 2027 vorgesehen. Laut Doku: Shared Secrets mit Versionen und Ablaufzeit, KMS-Verschlüsselung, Backup/Restore, Tags sowie Event-Benachrichtigung über SMN; Rotation nur selbst gebaut über FunctionGraph-Funktionen (keine native automatische Rotation). Cross-Region Replication und Resource-based Policies sind nicht dokumentiert. **Interim-Lösungen.** HashiCorp Vault auf CCE (empfohlen — Secrets, PKI, Dynamic Secrets), Kubernetes Secrets mit T Cloud Public KMS Encryption, oder Ansible Vault für statische Secrets. **DB-Rotation.** Secrets Manager + RDS Integration (automatische DB-Passwort-Rotation) hat kein direktes Pendant — nach CSMS-Launch ggf. über FunctionGraph + CSMS API nachbaubar.
migration.en: **CSMS not yet available.** T Cloud Public CSMS (Cloud Secret Management Service) is expected from 01.04.2027 per service description and from Q3 2027 per roadmap. Per docs: shared secrets with versions and expiration, KMS encryption, backup/restore, tags, and event notifications via SMN; rotation only self-built via FunctionGraph functions (no native automatic rotation). Cross-region replication and resource-based policies are not documented. **Interim solutions.** HashiCorp Vault on CCE (recommended — secrets, PKI, dynamic secrets), Kubernetes Secrets with T Cloud Public KMS encryption, or Ansible Vault for static secrets. **DB rotation.** Secrets Manager + RDS integration (automatic DB password rotation) has no direct equivalent — after CSMS launch potentially rebuildable via FunctionGraph + CSMS API.

desc.de: Managed SSL/TLS-Zertifikate. Kostenlose Public Certificates (exportierbare Public Certificates kostenpflichtig), automatisches Renewal, AWS Private CA (ehem. ACM Private CA), Integration mit ELB/CloudFront/API Gateway.
desc.en: Managed SSL/TLS certificates. Free public certificates (exportable public certificates are paid), automatic renewal, AWS Private CA (formerly ACM Private CA), integration with ELB/CloudFront/API Gateway.

tcpDesc.de: Kein Managed Certificate Service auf T Cloud Public. SSL Certificate Manager (SCM) existiert nicht als T Cloud Public-Service (Stand 11/2026, bestätigt durch Leistungsbeschreibung vom 09.10.2026 und Roadmap). Zertifikate müssen manuell beschafft und verwaltet werden.
tcpDesc.en: No managed certificate service on T Cloud Public. SSL Certificate Manager (SCM) does not exist as a T Cloud Public service (as of 11/2026, confirmed by service description of 09.10.2026 and roadmap). Certificates must be procured and managed manually.

alt.de: Let's Encrypt (certbot auf ECS), HashiCorp Vault PKI, Self-managed cert lifecycle
alt.en: Let's Encrypt (certbot on ECS), HashiCorp Vault PKI, self-managed cert lifecycle

migration.de: **Kein Managed-Zertifikatsdienst.** SSL Certificate Manager (SCM) existiert nicht als T Cloud Public-Service (Stand 11/2026, bestätigt durch Leistungsbeschreibung vom 09.10.2026 und Roadmap). **Alternativen.** Let's Encrypt (certbot) für automatische Zertifikate, eigene PKI aufbauen, oder kommerzielle Zertifikate manuell verwalten. **Automatisierung.** Automatische Zertifikats-Erneuerung muss selbst implementiert werden (Cronjob mit certbot). ACM Private CA → eigene CA mit OpenSSL oder Vault PKI auf CCE. **ELB/APIG.** Zertifikate manuell hochladen und vor Ablauf erneuern.
migration.en: **No managed certificate service.** SSL Certificate Manager (SCM) does not exist as a T Cloud Public service (as of 11/2026, confirmed by service description of 09.10.2026 and roadmap). **Alternatives.** Let's Encrypt (certbot) for automatic certificates, build own PKI, or manage commercial certificates manually. **Automation.** Automatic certificate renewal must be implemented yourself (cronjob with certbot). ACM Private CA → own CA with OpenSSL or Vault PKI on CCE. **ELB/APIG.** Upload certificates manually and renew before expiry.

desc.de: DDoS-Schutz. Shield Standard (kostenlos, automatisch) und Shield Advanced (erweiterter Schutz, Shield Response Team (SRT), Kosten-Schutz, SLA).
desc.en: DDoS protection. Shield Standard (free, automatic) and Shield Advanced (enhanced protection, Shield Response Team (SRT), cost protection, SLA).

tcpDesc.de: DDoS-Schutz für EIPs. Traffic Scrubbing, Anomalie-Erkennung, automatische Mitigation. Schützt vor SYN/UDP/HTTP Floods, CC-Attacken, SSL DoS, DNS-Attacken.
tcpDesc.en: DDoS protection for EIPs. Traffic scrubbing, anomaly detection, automatic mitigation. Protects against SYN/UDP/HTTP floods, CC attacks, SSL DoS, DNS attacks.

migration.de: **Automatischer Basis-Schutz.** Anti-DDoS ist automatisch für alle Elastic IPs aktiv. Schützt vor Web-Server-Attacken (SYN flood, HTTP flood, CC), Game-Attacken (UDP flood, TCP, Fragment), HTTPS-Attacken (SSL DoS/DDoS) und DNS-Attacken (Reflection, Flood, Cache-Miss). **Kein Shield Advanced.** Kein SLA-garantierter Schutz, kein Cost Protection, kein dediziertes Shield Response Team (SRT, ehem. DRT) — nur T-Systems Support. **Monitoring.** Attack-Statistiken und Monitoring-Reports verfügbar. **Kein CDN-Schutz.** CloudFront+Shield-Kombination hat kein Pendant (kein CDN auf T Cloud Public). Für L7-Schutz zusätzlich WAF nutzen.
migration.en: **Automatic basic protection.** Anti-DDoS is automatically active for all Elastic IPs. Protects against web server attacks (SYN flood, HTTP flood, CC), game attacks (UDP flood, TCP, fragment), HTTPS attacks (SSL DoS/DDoS), and DNS attacks (reflection, flood, cache-miss). **No Shield Advanced.** No SLA-guaranteed protection, no cost protection, no dedicated Shield Response Team (SRT, formerly DRT) — only T-Systems support. **Monitoring.** Attack statistics and monitoring reports available. **No CDN protection.** CloudFront+Shield combination has no equivalent (no CDN on T Cloud Public). Use WAF additionally for L7 protection.

equivNote.de: Anti-DDoS bietet automatischen DDoS-Schutz auf Netzwerk- und Anwendungsebene inkl. SYN/UDP/HTTP Flood, CC, SSL DoS und DNS-Attacken (vergleichbar Shield Standard). Kein Shield Advanced Pendant: kein dediziertes Shield Response Team (SRT, ehem. DRT), kein Cost Protection, kein SLA-basierter Credit. Für L7-Schutz WAF nutzen.
equivNote.en: Anti-DDoS provides automatic network- and application-layer DDoS protection incl. SYN/UDP/HTTP flood, CC, SSL DoS, and DNS attacks (comparable to Shield Standard). No Shield Advanced equivalent: no dedicated Shield Response Team (SRT, formerly DRT), no cost protection, no SLA-based credit. Use WAF for L7 protection.

tfNote.de: Anti-DDoS Basis-Schutz ist automatisch aktiv. Erweiterte Policies nur eingeschränkt per TF konfigurierbar.
tfNote.en: Anti-DDoS basic protection is automatically active. Extended policies only partially configurable via TF.

migration.de: **Regelformat-Inkompatibilität.** Suricata-kompatible Regeln aus AWS Network Firewall sind NICHT direkt übertragbar — CFW nutzt ein eigenes Regelformat. **Feature-Umfang.** CFW ist eine cloud-native Next-Gen Firewall mit IDPS, Access Control, Traffic-Analyse und Log-Audit. Stateful Inspection und Domain Filtering vorhanden. Schützt Internet- und VPC-Grenzen. **Regionale Verfügbarkeit.** Verfügbar in EU-DE und seit 21.07.2026 auch in EU-NL. IPv6-Adressen können derzeit nicht geschützt werden (CFW IPv6 Support laut Roadmap ab Q1 2027). **Logging.** Log-Integration über LTS (Log Tank Service). **Terraform.** Der T Cloud Public Provider unterstützt CFW-Instanzen, ACL-, IPS- und EIP-Schutz, Adress-, Service- und Domain-Gruppen, Black-/Whitelist-Regeln sowie die LTS-Log-Konfiguration. Die Firewall-Instanzressource unterstützt derzeit nur Internet-Schutz; kein Firewall Manager Pendant für Multi-Account-Verwaltung.
migration.en: **Rule format incompatibility.** Suricata-compatible rules from AWS Network Firewall are NOT directly transferable — CFW uses its own rule format. **Feature scope.** CFW is a cloud-native next-gen firewall with IDPS, access control, traffic analysis, and log audit. Stateful inspection and domain filtering available. Protects internet and VPC borders. **Regional availability.** Available in EU-DE and, since 21.07.2026, also in EU-NL. IPv6 addresses cannot be protected yet (CFW IPv6 support on the roadmap from Q1 2027). **Logging.** Log integration via LTS (Log Tank Service). **Terraform.** The T Cloud Public provider supports CFW instances, ACL, IPS and EIP protection, address, service and domain name groups, blacklist/whitelist rules, and LTS log configuration. The firewall instance resource currently supports Internet protection only; there is no Firewall Manager equivalent for multi-account management.

equivNote.de: CFW bietet IDPS, Zugriffskontrolle nach IP, Region und Domain (Domain Filtering) und Traffic-Analyse. Kein Suricata-Regelformat (eigenes Format). Kein AWS Firewall Manager Pendant für zentrale Multi-Account-Policy-Verwaltung. IPv6-Adressen derzeit nicht schützbar (laut Roadmap ab Q1 2027).
equivNote.en: CFW provides IDPS, access control by IP, region and domain (domain filtering), and traffic analysis. No Suricata rule format (proprietary format). No AWS Firewall Manager equivalent for centralized multi-account policy management. IPv6 addresses cannot be protected yet (roadmap: from Q1 2027).

tfNote.de: Teilunterstützung: CFW-Instanzen, ACL-, IPS- und EIP-Schutz, Adress-, Service- und Domain-Gruppen, Black-/Whitelist-Regeln sowie LTS-Log-Konfiguration sind verfügbar. Die Instanzressource unterstützt derzeit nur Internet-Schutz.
tfNote.en: Partial support: CFW instances, ACL, IPS and EIP protection, address, service and domain name groups, blacklist/whitelist rules, and LTS log configuration are available. The instance resource currently supports Internet protection only.

desc.de: Kein eigenständiger AWS-Dienst; Teilfunktionen über RDS Database Activity Streams, Aurora-Audit-Logs, CloudTrail und GuardDuty RDS Protection.
desc.en: No standalone AWS service; partial features via RDS Database Activity Streams, Aurora audit logs, CloudTrail and GuardDuty RDS Protection.

tcpDesc.de: Datenbank-Audit und -Schutz: Erfassung und Analyse von SQL-Zugriffen (RDS for MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQL Server, TaurusDB, DWS sowie auf ECS/BMS betriebene DBs), Erkennung von SQL-Injection und riskanten Operationen, Audit-Reports (z.B. für Compliance), Alarmierung. Nur EU-DE.
tcpDesc.en: Database audit and protection: capture and analysis of SQL access (RDS for MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQL Server, TaurusDB, DWS and DBs hosted on ECS/BMS), detection of SQL injection and risky operations, audit reports (e.g. for compliance), alerting. EU-DE only.
